dct_description_sm: "The GIS files in this package provide detailed coordinate data for international maritime boundaries and any specially designated maritime areas that might be associated with those boundaries. While this information has been compiled from primary sources such as bi-lateral treaties, arbitral awards and court judgments and carefully reproduced and reviewed, it is offered here for informational purposes only. International Mapping makes no representations or warranties as to its accuracy in every instance"--From metadata.

Accompanied by linked documents (Quarterly updates & international boundary news, Q1 2019; Database model & annexes, last revised February 2018; Land boundary disputes, December 2018; Standards and methodology, last revised May 2018).

Data layers include: archipelagic baselines, disputed areas, EEZ limits, Exclusive Economic Zones, extended continental shelf submissions, implied land limits, implied maritime limits, land boundaries, maritime boundaries, provisional equidistance, shared sovereignty areas, shared sovereignty zones, sovereignty areas, straight baselines, territorial sea limits, and undetermined sovereignty zones.
Publication statement: Ellicott City, MD : International Mapping , April 2019.
Title from Sovereign limits territorial sovereignty database signed license.
